Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1994
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT III OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-19/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be Balled the
Sindh Wildlife Protection Amendment Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 4th October, 1.993.

Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972

ACT III OF 1994
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT III OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-19/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972.--In the
Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972, hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 2, in clause (n), for the word and comma
"birds," the words and commas "birds, fish," shall be
substituted.

Amendment of section 14 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972

ACT III OF 1994
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT III OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-19/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Amendment of section 14 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972.--In the
said Ordinance, in section 14, after subsection (3); the following new
subsection shall be added:--
"(4) No
fishing waters in a wildlife sanctuary shall be leased, auctioned or in any way
used for the purpose of fishing or collection of lotus or roots thereof for
commercial purposes."

Abatement of leases etc

ACT III OF 1994
SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
ACT III OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-19/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
4. Abatement of leases etc.--Any lease or permission granted or any
agreement executed or auction held for the purpose mentioned in aforesaid
subsection (4) before the coming into force of the Sindh Wildlife Protection
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1992 shall stand annulled and be of no effect.

Repeal

1993, is hereby repealed.
